definitions.explanation: To join or arrange different elements together to create a whole or achieve a purpose.
To arrange items or people into pairs or groups.

notes:
{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to combine or put together.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ (to join, to put together) + ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to match) → to put together in combination

TRANSITIVITY:
- {組|く}み{合|あ}わせる (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧): to combine (something)
- ⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わさる→組み合わさる：17793_kumiawasaru⟧ (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧): to be combined (rare)

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせ→組み合わせ：13794_kumiawase⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing process of combining.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる (combine A and B)
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる (combine colors)
- ⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる (combine elements)

RELATED NOUN:
